Power Outages Announced in Delhi and Ashoknagar for Maintenance

Power supply will be disrupted for several hours in parts of Delhi and Ashoknagar on September 9th. In Delhi, 14 areas will be affected by power cuts lasting one to three hours due to grid upgrades and essential maintenance. Residents can check specific timings on the BSES Rajdhani Power Limited app. In Ashoknagar, a five-hour power outage is scheduled across multiple areas, divided into two shifts for maintenance work.
